t: The Nebo Larry 500 Flex Rechargeable LED Flashlight is a compact and versatile 500 lumen work light, an essential for trade professionals and DIY enthusiasts alike. Ideal for electricians working in fuse boxes or mechanics under bonnets, it features Flex-Power Technology, allowing power from the included rechargeable battery or 2 x AAA batteries, ensuring continuous illumination. Constructed with an impact-resistant aluminium body, this durable torch includes a powerful magnetic base and steel pocket clip for convenient hands-free lighting on site or in the workshop. USB C charging provides modern, efficient power replenishment for this portable lighting solution.
